subject: MAP + POC environment: API keys, org setup, allowlist & VPC peering
messages:
From: Sam Jenkins <sam.jenkins@medilogix.com>
To: olga_petrov <olga_petrov@redwood.ai>
Cc: Madiha Khan <madiha.khan@medilogix.com>
Date: Mon, 20 May 2028 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Kickoff request — MAP & POC environment details

Hi Olga —

Thanks for the quick demo last week. Madiha and I reviewed internally and we want to proceed with a short POC to validate latency and cost for our classification pipeline. Before we lock the kickoff date can you confirm the items you need from us to finalize the MAP and get the POC environment provisioned?

High level we expect:
- Non-prod API keys and example SDK config
- Org-level invite for our infra contact
- IP allowlist or VPC peering so the system can reach our testing cluster
- A short timeline for milestones (sandbox ready, smoke test, acceptance)

I attached our current security checklist — happy to adapt if Redwood needs additional info.

Thanks,
Sam
Sam Jenkins
Director of Data Platform, MediLogix
sam.jenkins@medilogix.com
+1 (415) 555-0198

From: olga_petrov <olga_petrov@redwood.ai>
To: Sam Jenkins <sam.jenkins@medilogix.com>
Cc: rishi_malhotra <rishi_malhotra@redwood.ai>, neha_kapoor <neha_kapoor@redwood.ai>
Date: Mon, 20 May 2028 11:08:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Kickoff request — MAP & POC environment details

Sam —

Appreciate the clear list. I uploaded a draft MAP and a POC network template to the Drive link below and attached MAP_v1.xlsx and the POC_Network_Template.pdf to this thread. To avoid delays, please confirm the items below:

1) Org & admin contact: who should we invite as the Redwood org admin? We need an owner to accept the org invitation (email + name).
2) IP ranges: if you prefer IP allowlisting, send the CIDR blocks for the test cluster (we will apply to the sandbox API gateway).
3) VPC peering: if you prefer peering instead, share the VPC ID, region, and the person who will handle the peering request on your side (we will provide our AWS account ID and peering template).
4) Smoke test owner & success criteria: a single bullet describing what acceptance means (e.g., 95th percentile latency < 120ms for 512 tokens, and inference throughput of X rps).

Operational notes:
- We can provision non-prod API keys within 48 business hours of org claim. Those keys are scoped for POC only and will be rotated at handoff.
- For VPC peering we require a short maintenance window (30m) to validate routes and test endpoints.
- If you need KMS-backed keys for the POC we can enable a wrapped-key mode; that will add ~2 business days.

Proposed milestone dates (editable in the MAP):
- Sandbox ready (Redwood): +3 business days after we receive org invite + IP/VPC details
- Smoke test by MediLogix: +2 business days after sandbox ready
- POC acceptance & close: +7 business days after smoke test

Let us know if that timeline fits. Happy to set a 30-minute kickoff to walk through the MAP and peering steps.

Best,
Olga Petrov
Senior Solutions Engineer — Redwood Inference
olga_petrov@redwood.ai
Attachments: MAP_v1.xlsx (spreadsheet), POC_Network_Template.pdf (doc)

From: Sam Jenkins <sam.jenkins@medilogix.com>
To: olga_petrov <olga_petrov@redwood.ai>
Cc: Madiha Khan <madiha.khan@medilogix.com>
Date: Tue, 21 May 2028 08:05:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Kickoff request — MAP & POC environment details

Olga —

Thanks — we prefer VPC peering for this POC. Details below:
- VPC ID: vpc-0a1b2c3d4e5f67890
- Region: us-west-2
- CIDR: 10.40.0.0/16 (testing cluster)
- Peering owner: Madiha Khan (madiha.khan@medilogix.com)

Acceptance criteria: 95th pctl latency < 120ms for 512-token calls over a 30-minute sustained run at 20 rps, and successful retrieval of embedding vectors within 250ms for typical requests.

Org admin: please invite infra-admin@medilogix.com (that's our infra service account alias).

We are available for kickoff tomorrow at 10:00 PT.

Cheers,
Sam

From: rishi_malhotra <rishi_malhotra@redwood.ai>
To: olga_petrov <olga_petrov@redwood.ai>, Sam Jenkins <sam.jenkins@medilogix.com>
Cc: neha_kapoor <neha_kapoor@redwood.ai>
Date: Tue, 21 May 2028 10:18:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Kickoff request — MAP & POC environment details

Sam / Madiha / Olga —

Thanks for the details. A few implementation notes from the infra side:
- Our AWS account ID for peering: 987654321000. I will send the CloudFormation peering template as an attachment after you confirm the VPC ID and route acceptance window.
- Route propagation: we'll ask your team to add two static routes for the 10.40.0.0/16 block to the peering connection. Peering tends to go through firewall inspection on your side; expect a short hold for security approval.
- IP allowlist fallback: we will also publish a temporary public endpoint with IP allowlist if peering is blocked; please confirm whether your security team allows temporary public endpoints during POC.
- API keys: Olga, can we provision two non-prod keys scoped to the MediLogix org (one for smoke tests, one for load tests)? Neha, do we need to tie any usage caps to those keys?

I'll be on the kickoff tomorrow at 10:00 PT to walk the peering steps.

-Rishi
Rishi Malhotra
Infrastructure Lead, Redwood Inference

From: neha_kapoor <neha_kapoor@redwood.ai>
To: Sam Jenkins <sam.jenkins@medilogix.com>, olga_petrov <olga_petrov@redwood.ai>, rishi_malhotra <rishi_malhotra@redwood.ai>
Date: Wed, 22 May 2028 16:40:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Kickoff request — MAP & POC environment details

Sam / Madiha —

Follow-up from today's call and next steps (I've attached the updated MAP_v1.xlsx with milestone dates filled):

1) Org invite: sent to infra-admin@medilogix.com — please accept the invite (it expires in 7 days).
2) VPC peering: Rishi initiated the peering request (CF template sent). Expect a security review on your side; Rishi will post status updates in this thread.
3) API keys: we provisioned two non-prod keys and placed them in a secure share (redwood-poc-keys-stub.txt attached). Keys are limited to POC usage and have a default cap (50k tokens/day). If you need higher throughput for load test, reply with target rps and token sizes and we'll adjust temporarily.
4) IP allowlist fallback: please confirm whether your security team approves a temporary allowlist; otherwise we will rely on the peering connection alone.

Milestones (finalized):
- 2028-05-23: Org accepted + sandbox account enabled
- 2028-05-24: VPC peering established / basic connectivity verified
- 2028-05-25: Smoke test executed by MediLogix (acceptance criteria above)
- 2028-05-31: POC acceptance & commercial close (if criteria met)

If anything changes to the timeline we will update the MAP in Drive. Thanks for moving quickly — ping me here once the invite is accepted and we'll kick off routing validation.

Regards,
Neha Kapoor
Engagement Manager, Redwood Inference
neha_kapoor@redwood.ai
Attachments: MAP_v1.xlsx (updated), redwood-poc-keys-stub.txt
